conditions.label: latency · steps=10
conditions.description: Actions reach the robot late. One step is 20 ms.
conditions.scenario_source:
version: 1
name: latency
description: Actions reach the robot late. One step is 20 ms.
env: aloha/insertion
episodes: 50
seed: 1000
sweep:
  name: steps
  values: [2, 5, 10]
perturbations:
  - action_latency: { steps: "${steps}" }
tags: [timing]
